notes.text: The supplied scripts use trusted abbreviations such as complete correct(b), correct sketch and no wrong working. This audit verifies their declared rubric facts; it does not prove recognition of real handwritten, drawn or uploaded evidence. Preserve that distinction during app validation.

The more-precise vector-angle final-form policy remains an explicit inherited F/application decision. Nothing here silently resolves it or changes the approved 1dp/no-artificial-decimal exact60/90 rules.

Keep multiple unlabelled function graphs, ambiguity, detached asymptote text and own-curve chord support in future actual-response marker fixtures. These cases are governed by the approved WO; the20 supplied expectation rows do not exercise every path.
